```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
fbs_cr <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# School position groups with few eligible players swing on one or two
# signings, so they drop out.
min_eligible <- 10L
school_pos_all <- school_position_rates(fbs_cr)
gaps <- school_pos_all |>
  filter(eligible >= min_eligible) |>
  mutate(
    side = if_else(
      2 * entered > eligible,
      "Most eligible players entered the NFL",
      "Half or fewer entered"
    ),
    tip = paste0(
      team,
      ", ",
      tolower(position_group),
      "\n",
      entered,
      " entered the NFL (",
      drafted,
      " drafted, ",
      udfa,
      " undrafted), ",
      eligible - entered,
      " did not, of ",
      eligible,
      " eligible"
    )
  )
n_small <- nrow(school_pos_all) - nrow(gaps)
p <- gap_beeswarm(
  gaps,
  entry_gap,
  side,
  c(
    "Most eligible players entered the NFL" = "#374151",
    "Half or fewer entered" = "#D1D5DB"
  ),
  tip,
  title = "Rate not entering the NFL minus rate entering, by school and position group",
  subtitle = sprintf(
    "Each dot is an FBS school in one position group, final seasons %s to %s; left of zero, most eligible players entered the NFL\n%s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out; hover a dot to find its school in every group",
    first_season,
    last_season,
    fmt(n_small),
    min_eligible
  ),
  x_label = "Rate not entering the NFL minus rate entering (percentage points)",
  caption = card_caption(release)
) +
  # Name the school furthest to the entering side in each group.
  geom_text(
    data = slice_min(gaps, entry_gap, n = 1, by = position_group, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      mutate(position_group = forcats::fct_rev(position_group)),
    aes(label = team),
    nudge_y = 0.4,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4,
    colour = "#374151",
    fontface = "bold"
  )
card_thumbnail(
  # The tile is small: a shorter subtitle and axis title, the legend in two rows.
  p +
    theme_card() +
    labs(subtitle = sprintf("Each dot is an FBS school in one position group, final seasons %s to %s; left of zero, most eligible players entered the NFL", first_season, last_season), x = "Not entering minus entering (points)") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)),
  "nfl-entry-by-school-position",
  release = release,
  height = 8
)
card_interactive(p, height_svg = 8)
```
